Your PC’s search bar isn’t actually searching your files. It’s checking something called an inverted index, which it’s been quietly building since the day you first booted up. So what is an inverted index, and how does it make search so fast? Why does Windows Search still miss files you KNOW exist? To find out why, We spoke to search researcher and absolute search legend Justin Zobel of the University of Melbourne.
